import sys

def max_beauty(n, numbers):
    if n == 0:
        return max(numbers)
    
    # Sort numbers to easily pick the largest elements
    numbers.sort()
    
    # The largest element will be the root of the recursion
    m = numbers.pop()
    
    # Recursively calculate the beauty of the four submatrices
    submatrix_size = 4 ** (n - 1)
    submatrix_beauties = [max_beauty(n - 1, numbers[:submatrix_size]),

                          max_beauty(n - 1, numbers[2 * submatrix_size:3 * submatrix_size]),
                          max_beauty(n - 1, numbers[3 * submatrix_size:])]
    
    return m + sum(submatrix_beauties)
